name: midtrans-payment
description: Midtrans Snap checkout + webhook handler + transaction history. Provider-isolated under components/providers/midtrans + actions/midtrans so Doku/Stripe land as siblings without API churn.

env.name: MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY
env.description: Midtrans Server Key (HMAC signing + Snap API calls).

env.name: MIDTRANS_CLIENT_KEY
env.description: Midtrans Client Key exposed to browser for Snap.js init.

notes: Existing `convex/features/payment/schema.ts` declares shared `paymentOrders`/`paymentWebhookEvents` across midtrans + doku — collides with 2026-05-12 namespace decision. Manifest captures target namespaced state; schema migration tracked in Operator Backlog. Snap.js loaded client-side via MIDTRANS_CLIENT_KEY; webhook verification uses MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY HMAC.
